data.define: Used to say something is pleasant or interesting.

misuse.text: Don't call a friend's messy room 'neat'.
misuse.why: Neat means tidy or cool, so it confuses.

publish.title: What does "neat" mean?
publish.value: Neat = Cool and nice. Example: "That's a neat trick!" (casual English, US).
